MC	<p>fec0_3b69</p> <h5>Unordered Tetrad Three Gene Mapping</h5><p>In this problem, you will use unordered tetrads to determine the between a single pair of genes and calculate the distances between them. The yeast <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> is used in this study. A cross has been performed to study the linkage relationships among three genes, and the resulting genotypes are summarized in the tables below.</p><h6>Characteristics of Recessive Phenotypes</h6><ul><li><strong><span style="color: #2c6e27;">Gene E</span></strong> is correlated with the '<span style="color: #2c6e27;"><i>elephant</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #2c6e27;">Gene E</span> cells absorb excessive amounts of liquid, resulting in giant, swollen cells.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #3a51c3;">Gene H</span></strong> is analogous to the '<span style="color: #3a51c3;"><i>hairy</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #3a51c3;">Gene H</span> cells develop long, thread-like filaments that extend outward, creating a hairy, shaggy texture on the colony.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #9c324d;">Gene P</span></strong> is associated with the '<span style="color: #9c324d;"><i>pebble</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #9c324d;">Gene P</span> produces colonies with a rough, uneven surface that resembles a collection of tiny pebbles.</li> </ul><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><tr><td align="center" style="border: 1px solid #888; padding: 2px;"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="156" height="120" viewBox="0 0 122 94" role="img" aria-label="Unordered ascus: +++, ehp, +++, ehp"><desc>Each recessive allele contributes its own color; plus alleles remain neutral. The yeast <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> is used in this study. A cross has been performed to study the linkage relationships among three genes, and the resulting genotypes are summarized in the tables below.</p><h6>Characteristics of Recessive Phenotypes</h6><ul><li><strong><span style="color: #a0341d;">Gene D</span></strong> is analogous to the '<span style="color: #a0341d;"><i>doubled</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #a0341d;">Gene D</span> cells display double or multiple budding, with several buds emerging simultaneously.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #006c65;">Gene F</span></strong> is affiliated with the '<span style="color: #006c65;"><i>fuzzy</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #006c65;">Gene F</span> colonies are covered in soft, fine filaments, giving them a fuzzy, cotton-like texture.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #3a51c3;">Gene X</span></strong> is affiliated with the '<span style="color: #3a51c3;"><i>xenon</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #3a51c3;">Gene X</span> cells emit a faint glow under UV light, as if they were fluorescent.</li> </ul><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><tr><td align="center" style="border: 1px solid #888; padding: 2px;"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="156" height="120" viewBox="0 0 122 94" role="img" aria-label="Unordered ascus: +++, dfx, +++, dfx"><desc>Each recessive allele contributes its own color; plus alleles remain neutral. MC	<p>9704_b3d9</p> <h5>Unordered Tetrad Three Gene Mapping</h5><p>In this problem, you will use unordered tetrads to determine the between a single pair of genes and calculate the distances between them. The yeast <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> is used in this study. A cross has been performed to study the linkage relationships among three genes, and the resulting genotypes are summarized in the tables below.</p><h6>Characteristics of Recessive Phenotypes</h6><ul><li><strong><span style="color: #a0341d;">Gene B</span></strong> is analogous to the '<span style="color: #a0341d;"><i>bubbly</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #a0341d;">Gene B</span> produces excessive gas bubbles during growth, causing foamy appearance of the media.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #57651f;">Gene C</span></strong> is analogous to the '<span style="color: #57651f;"><i>clumpy</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #57651f;">Gene C</span> grows in dense, irregular clusters, with cells clumping together rather than spreading smoothly.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #6741ba;">Gene M</span></strong> is connected with the '<span style="color: #6741ba;"><i>militant</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #6741ba;">Gene M</span> colonies are small, dense, and secrete compounds that inhibit the growth of nearby colonies.</li> </ul><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><tr><td align="center" style="border: 1px solid #888; padding: 2px;"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="156" height="120" viewBox="0 0 122 94" role="img" aria-label="Unordered ascus: +++, bcm, +++, bcm"><desc>Each recessive allele contributes its own color; plus alleles remain neutral. MC	<p>ff26_8f73</p> <h5>Unordered Tetrad Three Gene Mapping</h5><p>In this problem, you will use unordered tetrads to determine the between a single pair of genes and calculate the distances between them. The yeast <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> is used in this study. A cross has been performed to study the linkage relationships among three genes, and the resulting genotypes are summarized in the tables below.</p><h6>Characteristics of Recessive Phenotypes</h6><ul><li><strong><span style="color: #7e5400;">Gene N</span></strong> is correlated with the '<span style="color: #7e5400;"><i>nude</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #7e5400;">Gene N</span> cells have an unusually smooth surface with no visible external features or textures.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #006f4d;">Gene T</span></strong> is associated with the '<span style="color: #006f4d;"><i>toxic</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #006f4d;">Gene T</span> secretes a toxic compound that inhibits or kills other microbial colonies nearby.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #933376;">Gene X</span></strong> is correlated with the '<span style="color: #933376;"><i>xenon</i></span>' phenotype. MC	<p>8a09_19c5</p> <h5>Unordered Tetrad Three Gene Mapping</h5><p>In this problem, you will use unordered tetrads to determine the between a single pair of genes and calculate the distances between them. The yeast <i>Saccharomyces cerevisiae</i> is used in this study. A cross has been performed to study the linkage relationships among three genes, and the resulting genotypes are summarized in the tables below.</p><h6>Characteristics of Recessive Phenotypes</h6><ul><li><strong><span style="color: #2c6e27;">Gene A</span></strong> is analogous to the '<span style="color: #2c6e27;"><i>amber</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #2c6e27;">Gene A</span> cells develop a rich yellow-orange pigmentation, giving the colony a warm, amber hue.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #306094;">Gene M</span></strong> is linked with the '<span style="color: #306094;"><i>militant</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #306094;">Gene M</span> colonies are small, dense, and secrete compounds that inhibit the growth of nearby colonies.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #9c324d;">Gene X</span></strong> is affiliated with the '<span style="color: #9c324d;"><i>xenon</i></span>' phenotype. A budding yeast that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #9c324d;">Gene X</span> cells emit a faint glow under UV light, as if they were fluorescent.</li> </ul><table style="border-collapse: collapse; color: #202020; background: #ffffff;"><tr><td align="center" style="border: 1px solid #888; padding: 2px;"><svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="156" height="120" viewBox="0 0 122 94" role="img" aria-label="Unordered ascus: +++, amx, +++, amx"><desc>Each recessive allele contributes its own color; plus alleles remain neutral.
